snippet.title: 5 conversion leaks hiding on your homepage right now
snippet.description:
The 5 conversion leaks we keep finding on founder sites — each with a one-line fix.

01 The buried CTA — one primary action, inside the first screen
02 The clever headline — say what you sell in 5 seconds
03 Too many doors — every extra choice taxes the one that pays you
04 Proof nobody can check — specific beats superlative, if it's true
05 The button that isn't — if it looks tappable, make it tappable

Velyr is an agent that finds one conversion leak on your site every week and ships the fix as a real pull request. You approve with one tap. → https://velyr.io
